summary: Build a local-first university course generator with a Python API/generator and React website. The Python service keeps the API key in a local .env file and calls the specified Responses API; the initial course is Calculus 101 and the UI supports richer assignment, midterm, and final interactions with structured generated content.

questions.question: Describe the features or API routes for Python Course Generator API.
questions.answer: Provide local API routes for course generation and structured course content requests. For each model request, load the API key from a local .env file and POST to https://apidev.hku.hk/openai/v1/responses with model gpt-6-luna and reasoning effort xhigh. Keep all model calls and credentials on the Python side; do not make browser-side model calls.
